summary: Spawns a wheel contact particle (tire spray / smoke / dust). Reads remaining capacity at this+0x58 and returns it if not positive; otherwise allocates a particle slot from a circular buffer, seeds slot element 2 from a scoring delegation or dbl_8AFEA0, and writes four quad vertices into the texture buffer. Surface type this+0x4 == 8 selects the wet/smoke variant: sets slot element 3 from lifetime plus this+0x30, computes a per-surface alpha clamped to [0,1] using this+0x40 and a scoring delta, stores it in slot element 25 and writes it back scaled by 63.5 at a3+24. Non-8 surfaces store a maximum-lifetime marker instead. Returns the last PixelWriteToTextureBuffer result.

local_names.a3: corner A data (position, offset, contact value)
local_names.a4: corner B data (position, offset, contact value)

operations.description: Read remaining capacity at this+0x58; if not positive, return it without spawning.
Allocate a particle slot from the emitter's circular buffer via CircularBufferSlotAlloc.
If scoring gate dword_8AB6E4 == 2, delegate the lifetime query through Delegation(&dword_8AB6EC); otherwise take dbl_8AFEA0 as the seed.
Store the seed lifetime into the allocated slot's element 2.
Branch on surface type this+0x4 == 8 selecting the wet/smoke particle variant.
Type-8 variant: slot element 3 gets the lifetime plus the emitter duration field this+0x30.
Type-8 variant: scale the byte values at a4+24 and a3+24 by 0.0039370079.
When scoring gate dword_8AB6E4 == 2, query VehicleDataAccessor(&dword_8AB6EC); if it returns 5 use 0.0, otherwise use FloatDifference(&dword_8AB6EC); when not 2 use dbl_8AFE98.
Type-8 variant: v9 = scaled surface value - scoring delta * this+0x40, clamped to [0,1]; store v9 in slot element 25.
Type-8 variant: scale v9 by 63.5 and write the integer result back to a3+24.
Non-8 surfaces: slot element 3 is set to the maximum float 3.4028235e38 (no contact modification).
Build the first two quad vertices: vertex 0 from a3 plus its +12/+16/+20 offset, vertex 1 from a4 plus its +12/+16/+20 offset.
Write vertex 0 into the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer using the value at a3+24.
Write vertex 1 into the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer using the value at a4+24.
Build the last two quad vertices: vertex 2 from a4 minus its +12/+16/+20 offset, vertex 3 from a3 minus its +12/+16/+20 offset.
Write vertex 2 into the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer using the value at a4+24.
Write vertex 3 into the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer using the value at a3+24 and return its result.
